native_timeout.disposition: Existing 180-second index-only suite command timeout on Windows; retained failure and retried failed job once with unchanged code, timeout, assertions and workflow. No test assertion failure was reported.

preliminary_baseline.reason: Interrupted owned preliminary baseline to add explicit whole-matrix guards. No completion claimed; failed/partial artifacts retained.

findings.issue: Validation sink can obscure time in actual batch production
findings.disposition: Time disjoint batch and fully validating sink regions; retain end-to-end timing, instrumentation overhead and ordered results.

findings.issue: Per-case guards do not independently enforce the whole input matrix
findings.disposition: Require exactly four families, both specified sizes and three complete verified trials, with negative guard tests.

findings.issue: Per-worker strict reopen would repeat significant validation work
findings.disposition: Document one validated coordinator owner and bounded trusted ordinal starts for future workers; preserve hashing and canonical replay.

findings.issue: Profile timers do not identify hot functions or prove parallel benefit
findings.disposition: Label wall-clock phases explicitly; defer finer I/O/codec/assembly attribution and actual parallel qualification to later tasks.

findings.issue: EOF framing requirement could be read as overriding empty-range laziness
findings.disposition: Clarify that consumed nonempty ranges validate EOF framing, while empty [total,total) and zero accepted limits remain lazy; task 037 must test both.

unrun_reason: No production, dependency, format or existing M5 worker changes. Runtime hashes match merged M5; preserved source-bound full acceptance remains in docs/evidence/035-results.json.
next_task: 037: exact bounded serial ordinal ranges; pending review
